rationale: Dorea longicatena is a butyrate-producing anaerobe. Glucose, lactate, arginine, and arabinose are fermented via mixed-acid fermentation to butyrate (primary), acetate, and CO₂. Nitrogen limitation from 8 mmol N/gDW/h (NH₄⁺ + arginine) constrains growth to 0.8 /h. Carbon balance verified: 140 mmol C in supports 30.4 mmol C (biomass) + 94.3 mmol C (fermentation products).
